title: Findings trend view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's findings-trend view: each repository's findings replayed bucket by bucket to as_of and summed over the scope (named products and teams, else every repository), each metric's direction, and the accepted-risk register standing at as_of. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

as_of.description: The point in time the series is replayed to: the filter's, else when the view was built.

points.description: One point per bucket in which any repository in scope had reported findings, oldest first, limited to the filter's window when one is given. Empty when nothing was reported.

directions.description: At most one direction per metric, in the metric vocabulary's order (Core orders them; JSON Schema checks presence and uniqueness, not order), computed over the last bucket and up to three before it. A metric whose value is unknown (null) in any of those buckets has no direction, because unknown is not zero, so only risk_index and accepted_risk_index can be absent when there are points. Empty when there are no points.

accepted.description: The accepted-risk register at as_of: every finding in scope standing as risk accepted, critical first and unrated last, then highest CVSS score, with every unscored finding after every scored one (a score of 0 still ranks above an unscored finding).

index.description: Sum over the standing findings of each one's CVSS score, else its severity band's midpoint. Null (unknown) when any of them has neither.

cvss_score.description: CVSS base score from 0 to 10 as an exact decimal string. Core emits the shortest fixed-point form, the same from every storage backend (for example "9.8", "10", "0"); the pattern also admits trailing zeros, so compare as decimals. Null when the finding is unscored.

point.description: One bucket, summed over the repositories that reported by its end. Open counts, accepted, hardening and the risk indexes stand at the bucket's end; new, resolved, regressions, false positives and decisions happened within it.

open_by_severity.description: Open findings by effective severity at the bucket's end. The five rated keys are always present; unrated appears only when at least one open finding has no severity.

new.description: Findings first seen within the bucket.

resolved.description: Findings that became resolved within the bucket (remediation velocity).

accepted.description: Findings standing as risk accepted at the bucket's end.

hardening.description: Findings standing as hardening at the bucket's end.

false_positives.description: Findings that became false positives within the bucket.

regressions.description: Regression decisions recorded within the bucket.

mttr_days.description: Mean days from first seen to the resolving decision, over the findings resolved within the bucket and weighted by each repository's resolutions; null when none was resolved with a resolving decision.

risk_index.description: The open findings' risk index at the bucket's end.

accepted_risk_index.description: The risk-accepted findings' risk index at the bucket's end.

reported.description: Repositories in scope that had reported findings by the bucket's end.

dispositioned.description: Of those, the repositories with at least one recorded decision by the bucket's end.

fp_rate.description: false_positives as a percentage of decisions, to one decimal; 0 when no decision was recorded within the bucket.

coverage.description: dispositioned as a percentage of reported (ledger coverage), to one decimal; 0 when nothing was reported.

direction.description: A metric's last bucket against the mean of up to three buckets before it. Within a 10% dead band, or when both are 0, it is flat; otherwise it is rising or falling, and worsening when it moves against the metric's good direction.

metric.description: velocity is resolved per bucket; mttr counts an unknown MTTR as 0; coverage and velocity are good rising, every other metric is good falling.

last.description: The metric in the last bucket; every metric is nonnegative.

baseline.description: Mean of up to three buckets before the last, to two decimals; null when there is only one bucket.

change_pct.description: Percentage change of last against baseline, to one decimal; null when there is no baseline or it is 0.

rising.description: Null when flat or when there is no baseline.

worsening.description: True only when rising is not null and the metric moves against its good direction.

accepted_risk.description: A finding standing as risk accepted: unfixed and unmitigated, and who accepted it.

repository_url.description: Raw registered URL, preserved as data.

title.description: Raw untrusted finding title, preserved as data rather than authored Markdown or HTML.

severity.description: Effective severity; null when the finding is unrated.

accepted_at.description: When the latest risk-acceptance decision up to as_of was recorded; null when none is found.

accepted_by.description: The principal of that decision, raw; null when none is found.

rationale.description: That decision's rationale, raw and truncated to 160 characters; null when none was given.
